items.title: Terraform 1.16 completes Actions lifecycles and brings imports into child modules
items.blurb: Terraform 1.16 adds destroy-time Actions and reusable imports in child modules, keeping more infrastructure lifecycle operations in Terraform.

items.title: Container Apps Express Reaches GA on a Newly Generally Available Sandbox Layer
items.blurb: Microsoft has made Azure Container Apps Express generally available alongside Container Apps Sandboxes, the microVM compute layer it runs on.

items.title: Presentation: Beyond Observability: Evolving Production Operations in the Age of AI
items.blurb: The panelists discuss how production operations are evolving with AI, turning operational data into actionable insights for incident response.
